title: 2.2 Toll Trap
concept: Bellman-Ford (Negative Weights & Reachable Negative Cycle Detection)
objective: Run V-1 edge-relaxation passes with negative toll-rebate edges and check the V-th pass for a source-reachable negative cycle.
controls: Select edges to relax or run pass | [R] Run | [S] Step | [Backspace] Restart
start_status: Toll rebates introduce negative edge weights. Gameplay heat is tracked separately.
hints: Path 0 -> 2 -> 1 -> 3 -> 4 yields 7 + (-3) + 5 + (-2) = 7 without any negative cycle.
Algorithmic edge weights stay negative; gameplay heat uses non-negative penalties.
